title: Unibet takes its betting sites offline after a cyberattack, according to its own statement
date_note: Date of GamblingNews' report; the article gives no time for the shutdown.
place: Not stated (Unibet sites in multiple countries)
geo_basis: the source names no country or city; region pin, not a location of the attack
summary: GamblingNews reports that Unibet said on X it had temporarily taken Unibet offline as a safety precaution following a cyberattack, and is working to restore access safely. Unibet sites in multiple countries were reportedly affected, and visitors are redirected to a maintenance page. The article says Unibet did not disclose further details of the attack.
plain: Unibet says a cyberattack led it to take its betting site offline as a precaution. It is working to restore access; no details of the attack have been given.
exec: A gambling operator's sites in multiple countries are reportedly offline after a cyberattack, with no restoration time given.
action: Customers: wait for Unibet's own updates before logging in; do not follow unsolicited messages about the outage.
